name: mirage
text: They measure different things, so they differ by design, but a gap of about $286 is too big to wave off. All-time profit (+$43.13) is only the 4,929 bets and bids the Tracker logged since Oct 11, valued at their listed prices with a final result. Novig's own ledger (-$242.62) is every cent that moved in the Vigilant subaccount: every fee, maker credit, payout and stake, including activity before Oct 11 and any order the Tracker never saw (hand bets, bids filled while the phone was closed, voids/refunds that settle differently). Open bets are also treated differently (left out on one side, counted at cost on the other). The ledger is the true money; the Tracker's figure is probably too high. I haven't yet split the gap into its causes: I'm adding a task to reconcile the two by date and by order, and will tell you which of those explains it.
